provider: LINDAT/CLARIAH-CZ (Charles University, UFAL) — DSpace language-data repository

free_tier.stated: Deposit is free with no published byte ceiling ('It is free and safe'); the only stated object limit is operational — CLARIN-family DSpace instances handle files above 2 GB by special arrangement rather than refusing them. Individual deposited corpora routinely run to tens of GB.

egress.terms: Free. Public items download without login; licence-gated items need an account and an e-signed licence. No metering, no egress pricing — this is a national research-infrastructure node.

tooling: DSpace REST/OAI-PMH plus a documented submission workflow (repository/mydspace); handles as PIDs; SWORD-style deposit contract per collection ('Distribution License Agreement'). CLARIN SPF / eduGAIN SSO, and a local account on request.
chaining: Unlimited items per depositor x no per-item byte cap. Multiple CLARIN centres (LINDAT, CLARIN.SI, CLARIN-D, plus 20+ national nodes) each run their own DSpace with the same open door, so the chain is 'one account per centre'.

limits.value: review and the >2 GB manual step make it a scripted-assisted path rather than a fire-a

limits_note: Account is the gate, not bytes: you need an eduGAIN institutional login, a CLARIN account, or a manually granted local account. Files >2 GB need help-desk handling. Every deposit signs a Distribution License Agreement and must carry adequate metadata, so bulk dumping of undocumented blobs will be rejected.
reliability_note: Run by UFAL with an explicit preservation policy since 2010; stable, but the metadata/contract review and the >2 GB manual step make it a scripted-assisted path rather than a fire-and-forget API.

evidence.proved: 'It is free and safe'; 'If you don't have an academic account that works with us, let us know. We will make you a local account.'
